steps.en: Install the wrapper into your Python environment
steps.zh: 把包装进你的 Python 环境
steps.code: pip install praw · uv add praw

steps.en: Register a script-type Reddit app, then build a client from its credentials
steps.zh: 注册一个 script 型 Reddit app，用凭据建客户端实例

steps.en: Handles Reddit OAuth tokens and paces every request to follow the API rules — no sleep() in your code
steps.zh: 管 token、按 API 规则控速，代码里不用写 sleep()

steps.en: Iterate a subreddit listing like plain domain code
steps.zh: 像写普通领域代码一样遍历 subreddit 列表

steps.en: Issues the network request only when an attribute is first touched, and paginates listings transparently
steps.zh: 只在属性首次被访问时才发网络请求（惰性对象），并透明翻页

value.en: Reddit data as Pythonic objects — OAuth, pagination and rate-limit compliance stop being your problem
value.zh: Reddit 数据变成 Pythonic 对象——OAuth、分页、限速合规都不再是你的事
